fusions.name: Cutting Reef
fusions.desc: Grows a reef of sharp coral 5 tiles long for 6 seconds, dealing 10 damage to anything that crosses it and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Budding Hex
fusions.desc: Throws a bud of calcifying arcana that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Grown Outcrop
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, grows a coral head that stands for 12 seconds and stings enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
